snippet.title: It Came From Within - Teaser Trailer - Somewhat Software
snippet.description:
Life was good inside the Faraday luxury apartments complex. Until one day when something crawled up the kitchen sink drain. Now it is your responsibility. Keep it inside...or else.

It Came From Within is Somewhat Software's newest game, to be released in late April of 2022.

Wishlist it now on Steam :
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1944740/It_Came_From_Within/
